widget.name: AG Grid
widget.description: Advanced data grid using AG Grid

property.caption: Data source
property.description: The data source for the grid

property.caption: Columns
property.description: Define the columns to display

property.caption: Header
property.description: Column header text

property.caption: Attribute
property.description: Attribute to display

property.caption: Data Type
property.description: Override how the grid interprets this column for sorting, filtering, and formatting. Auto uses the Mendix attribute type.

property.caption: Hidden Column
property.description: Keep this column hidden in the grid UI while still allowing it to participate in filters, sorts, or templates.

property.caption: Text Alignment
property.description: Horizontal alignment of cell content. Auto uses smart defaults: numbers/dates right-aligned, text left-aligned, links/badges centered.

property.caption: Width Type
property.description: How to size this column

property.caption: Fixed Width (px)
property.description: Column width in pixels (only used when Width Type is "Fixed")

property.caption: Flex Value
property.description: Flex ratio for flexible columns (like CSS 1fr, 2fr, etc. - only used when Width Type is "Flexible")

property.caption: Minimum Width (px)
property.description: Minimum width for flexible and auto columns

property.caption: Maximum Width (px)
property.description: Maximum width for flexible and auto columns (0 = no limit)

property.caption: Resizable
property.description: Enable column resizing

property.caption: Draggable
property.description: Allow this column to be reordered by dragging the column header

property.caption: Pinned Position
property.description: Pin this column to the left or right side of the grid header.

property.caption: Allow Pinning in Grid Menu
property.description: Allow end users to pin or unpin this column through the column options menu.

property.caption: Sortable
property.description: Enable sorting for this column

property.caption: Default Sort
property.description: Set initial sort direction for this column when grid loads

property.caption: Sort Priority
property.description: Order for multi-column sorting (0 = first, 1 = second, etc.). Use high number like 999 if not using multi-sort.

property.caption: Include in Sort Options
property.description: Make this column available in the sort dropdown

property.caption: Filter
property.description: Enable filtering for this column

property.caption: Filter Location
property.description: Where to display the filter for this column

property.caption: Use Date Range Picker
property.description: Show start and end date inputs in the filter drawer instead of a list of values. Only applies to date attributes.

property.caption: Use Relative Date Range
property.description: Show a dropdown of relative ranges (last 7 days, last 30 days, etc.) in the filter drawer. Only applies to date attributes.

property.caption: Floating Filter
property.description: Show the filter below the column header.

property.caption: Formatter (Built-in)
property.description: Format the cell value display using built-in formatters

property.caption: Custom Formatter Name
property.description: Name of a custom formatter to use (e.g., "BadgeMaker"). If specified, this overrides the built-in formatter above. Must match a formatter name from the Custom Formatters configuration.

property.caption: Custom Prefix
property.description: Text to prepend to the value (e.g., "VAF ", "ID-", "#")

property.caption: Custom Suffix
property.description: Text to append to the value (e.g., " kg", " units", "%")

property.caption: Template
property.description: Optional template to display instead of the raw value. Use ${attributeId} placeholders referencing column attributes (including hidden ones).

property.caption: Link Action
property.description: Action to execute when link is clicked (Show Page, Microflow, Nanoflow, etc.). The context object will be the row's data object.

property.caption: Link URL Pattern (Legacy)
property.description: LEGACY: URL pattern with ${value} placeholder. Prefer using Link Action for proper Mendix navigation.

property.caption: Link Text (optional)
property.description: Custom text for the link. Leave empty to use the cell value. Supports ${value} placeholder.

property.caption: Status Mapping (JSON)
property.description: JSON array for status badge mapping. Example: [{"value":1,"label":"Approved","className":"badge-success"},{"value":2,"label":"Denied","className":"badge-danger"}]

property.caption: Enable Column Menus
property.description: Show the three-dot menu icon in column headers. Disable to hide column menu access globally for all columns.

property.caption: Enable Header Filter Buttons
property.description: Show filter icons in column headers. Disable to hide header filter icons while keeping filtering capability for toolbar/drawer filters.

property.caption: Enable Floating Filters
property.description: Show floating filter rows below column headers by default. Individual columns can override this setting.

property.caption: Enable View Selector
property.description: Show grid/list/card view selector

property.caption: Default View (Desktop)
property.description: Default view mode on desktop screens

property.caption: Default View (Mobile)
property.description: Default view mode on mobile screens

property.caption: Custom Card Template (HTML)
property.description: HTML template for custom card view. Use {{FieldName}} placeholders for dynamic data. FieldName must match column headers exactly. Leave empty to use default HardenCardView.

property.caption: Custom List Template (HTML)
property.description: HTML template for custom list view. Use {{FieldName}} placeholders for dynamic data. FieldName must match column headers exactly. Leave empty to use default HardenListView.

property.caption: Enable Filter Drawer
property.description: Show a slide-out drawer for filters

property.caption: Custom Formatters
property.description: Define reusable custom formatters that can be used in templates and columns

property.caption: Formatter Name
property.description: Unique name for this formatter (e.g., "statusBadge", "userAvatar"). Use this name in templates like {{formatterName("FieldName")}}

property.caption: Formatter Type
property.description: Type of formatter implementation

property.caption: Formatter Code
property.description: JavaScript function body. Must return a string or HTML. Available variables: value (field value), item (row object), column (column config). Example: return `${value}`;

property.caption: Formatter Configuration (JSON)
property.description: Optional JSON configuration for this formatter (e.g., color mappings, URL patterns). Accessible as 'config' variable in code.

property.caption: Enable Side Bar
property.description: Show the AG Grid side bar so users can access column and filter panels.

property.caption: Enable Status Bar
property.description: Show the AG Grid status bar with row counts and selection information.

property.caption: Enterprise Key
property.description: Your AG Grid Enterprise license key. Leave empty for Community edition. This value is masked in Studio.

property.caption: Enable Context Menu
property.description: Show the AG Grid right-click context menu for columns and cells. Disable to prevent context menu access.

property.caption: Use Local Storage
property.description: Persist view, filters, search, and sort per user in the browser. Disable to fall back to widget defaults each time.

property.caption: Contains in Toolbar
property.description: Show the "Contains" search field in the toolbar for quick filtering.

property.caption: Enable Toolbar Filter Search
property.description: Enable search/autocomplete functionality within toolbar multi-select filters. Disable for simpler dropdowns.

property.caption: Enable Pagination
property.description: Enable pagination for the grid

property.caption: Page Size
property.description: Number of rows per page

property.caption: Height
property.description: Grid height in pixels

property.caption: Theme
property.description: AG Grid theme

property.caption: Theme Variant
property.description: Choose the light or dark variant of the selected theme. Auto follows the user’s system preference.

property.caption: Enable Data Polling
property.description: Automatically check for new data added by other users

property.caption: Polling Interval (seconds)
property.description: How often to check for new data (in seconds). Minimum 10 seconds.

property.caption: Enable Notifications
property.description: Show toast notifications when new data is detected by polling

property.caption: Toast Position
property.description: Where to display toast notifications on screen

property.caption: Auto Hide Duration (ms)
property.description: How long to show notifications before auto-hiding. Set to 0 to require manual dismissal.

property.caption: On Row Click
property.description: Action to execute when a row is clicked
